name: modelverse-rag-eval-v2
description: RAG evaluation dataset v2: curated corpus with gold labels covering paraphrase, negation/distractor, multi-hop, numeric, and multi-gold cases for hybrid retrieval

corpus.text: Paris is the capital and largest city of France. It sits on the Seine river in western Europe and is known for the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre museum, and its cafe culture.
Tokyo is the capital of Japan and the world's most populous metropolitan area. The city blends neon districts like Shibuya with tranquil shrines and cherry blossom parks.
Cairo is the capital of Egypt and the largest city in the Arab world. The Giza pyramid complex and the Great Sphinx lie on its outskirts.

Electric cars use rechargeable lithium-ion battery packs instead of gasoline engines. Charging at home overnight typically covers daily commuting distances, while fast-charging stations refill most of a battery in about thirty minutes.

Range anxiety describes the fear that an electric vehicle will run out of charge before reaching a charger. Modern electric cars regularly achieve ranges of 250 to 300 miles per full charge, reducing this concern for most drivers.

Local LLM inference runs language models directly on your own hardware. Quantization reduces model weights to 4-bit or 8-bit integers so large networks fit into consumer GPU memory with minimal quality loss.

GGUF is a binary file format used by llama.cpp to package quantized model weights and tokenizer metadata in a single file. A .gguf file also embeds model metadata such as parameter count, architecture, and context length.

Vector search finds documents by comparing embedding vectors with cosine similarity instead of matching exact keywords. Hybrid retrieval combines semantic vector ranking with keyword matching, fusing both ranked lists using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
Sourdough bread rises through wild yeast and lactobacilli rather than commercial baker's yeast. A mature starter doubles in size within six hours when fed equal weights of flour and water.
A marathon covers 26.2 miles or 42.195 kilometers. Elite runners finish in just over two hours, while recreational runners commonly train for sixteen weeks before race day.
The Louvre museum sits in central Paris on the Seine's right bank. Its glass pyramid entrance leads to collections spanning Egyptian antiquities, Renaissance painting, and the Mona Lisa.
Lyon is France's gastronomic capital and a major city in the Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes region. It is not the national capital; that distinction belongs to Paris.
The Greater Tokyo Area holds roughly 37 million residents, making it the most populous metropolitan area on earth. The 23 special wards alone house about 14 million people.
Kyoto was Japan's imperial capital for over a thousand years until 1868, when the capital moved to Tokyo. Today Kyoto is famed for temples, geisha districts, and autumn foliage.
The Nile river flows north through Cairo before fanning into the delta. Felucca sailboats and dinner cruises carry tourists along the Cairo waterfront each evening.
The Giza pyramid complex near Cairo opens daily from 8am to 4pm, with the Great Pyramid interior admitting a limited number of visitors per day by timed ticket.
Charging an electric car at home costs roughly 10 to 15 cents per kilowatt-hour in most regions, so a full 60 kWh charge runs about 6 to 9 dollars. Public fast chargers cost two to three times more.
Long-range electric models such as the Tesla Model 3 Long Range and Hyundai Ioniq 6 advertise EPA ranges above 300 miles, while budget models cluster near 200 miles per charge.

Quantization maps 16-bit floating point weights to 4-bit or 8-bit integers using per-group scale factors. Four-bit quantization shrinks a model to roughly one quarter of its original size with small accuracy loss.
Ollama serves local models through a REST API on port 11434. Running ollama serve starts the daemon, after which ollama run pulls and chats with models like llama3 directly from the terminal.

Chunking splits long documents into overlapping passages, typically 500 to 1000 characters with 10 to 20 percent overlap. Overlap preserves sentence context that would otherwise be cut at chunk boundaries.

BM25 ranks keyword matches using term frequency, document length normalization, and inverse document frequency. It remains the standard baseline that semantic search must beat in retrieval benchmarks.

Sourdough hydration expresses water weight as a percentage of flour weight. Most beginner recipes use 70 to 75 percent hydration, while wetter 80 percent doughs yield open crumbs but are harder to shape.
First-time marathon training plans span 16 to 20 weeks with peak weeks near 40 miles. Plans alternate long slow runs, tempo sessions, and rest days to build endurance without injury.

Transformer attention computes query-key dot products scaled by the square root of head dimension, then applies softmax to weight value vectors. Multi-head attention runs this process in parallel subspaces.
Common embedding dimensions range from 384 for MiniLM to 1536 for large cloud models. Higher dimensions capture finer distinctions but cost more storage and slow down similarity search.

The Python Global Interpreter Lock allows only one thread to execute bytecode at a time. CPU-bound threads therefore gain little from threading, while I/O-bound code and multiprocessing sidestep the lock.

Server-Sent Events stream text from server to browser over a single HTTP connection using the text/event-stream content type. Each event is a data: line terminated by a blank line, and the client reconnects automatically.

WebSockets open a bidirectional channel suited to chat and collaboration, while Server-Sent Events are simpler for one-way server-to-client streams such as token output. SSE reconnects natively; WebSockets need manual reconnection.
Estimate VRAM as parameters times bytes per weight: an 8B model at 4-bit needs about 4 to 5 GB for weights plus 1 to 2 GB for context and overhead. Add context memory linearly with sequence length.

cases.query: What is the capital of France?
cases.answer: Paris is the capital of France. The city sits on the Seine river.

cases.query: Which city is the capital of Japan?
cases.answer: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

cases.query: Where are the pyramids located in Egypt?
cases.answer: The Giza pyramids are located near Cairo, the capital of Egypt.

cases.query: How do electric cars charge their batteries?

cases.query: How can I run large language models on my own GPU?
cases.answer: You can run local LLM inference by loading quantized GGUF model files with llama.cpp so the network fits in consumer GPU memory.

cases.answer: Hybrid retrieval combines semantic vector search with keyword matching and fuses the two ranked lists using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
